name: buyer-journey-e2e

identity.note: Plus-alias of matt@ryan-realty.com so delivery is verifiable in a real inbox. Fresh browser profile (no matt@ admin session). All sends go ONLY to this address.

steps.evidence: object holding every key named in the step's evidence_required; *_file keys are paths relative to results.json, *_count keys are numbers, *_ms keys are numbers, *_confirmed keys are boolean true, *_query_output keys hold the raw SQL result pasted verbatim

findings.title: one line
retested_steps: step ids re-run after the fix (required when status=fixed)

findings_policy.P0: blocks the journey or shows wrong data — must be fixed and retested before the run can pass
findings_policy.P1: broken feature with a workaround — must be fixed and retested before the run can pass

sql_note: All tables used here (crm_people, saved_listings, saved_searches, cmas, email_events, crm_timeline) use lowercase column names — no mixed-case quoting needed. Run every query fresh in this session and paste the raw output into the *_query_output evidence key. Filters must target the test identity only.

steps.action: Start from a public touchpoint (Google Business Profile, Instagram bio link, or a live ad landing page). Click through to the site. Sign up as the test identity.
assertions: A crm_people row exists for the test email with non-null source
SQL: select id, source, source_url, created_at from crm_people where emails::text ilike '%buyertest%' and deleted = false

steps.action: Search homes in RiverWest (Bend). Spot-check 3 result listings against their detail pages: each must actually be in RiverWest.
assertions: Results match the geography
Search results render in under 2 seconds

steps.action: Search homes in Old Bend. Spot-check 3 result listings against their detail pages: each must actually be in Old Bend.
assertions: Results match the geography
Search results render in under 2 seconds

steps.action: Search multi-family properties in Bend. Spot-check 3 result listings against their detail pages: each must be multi-family and in Bend.
assertions: Results match property type and geography
Search results render in under 2 seconds

steps.action: Search multi-family properties in Redmond. Spot-check 3 result listings against their detail pages: each must be multi-family and in Redmond.
assertions: Results match property type and geography
Search results render in under 2 seconds

steps.action: Like/save at least 3 homes per search, 12+ total, from the search result and detail pages.
assertions: SQL: select count(*) from saved_listings where user_id = '<site user uuid for the test identity>'

steps.action: Save all four searches with the exact criteria used in phase 2.
assertions: SQL: select id, name, filters, result_count from saved_searches where user_id = '<site user uuid>'

steps.action: Open the buyer dashboard. Confirm all saved homes and all four saved searches appear with correct criteria. Hard-refresh and confirm nothing is lost or duplicated.
assertions: Dashboard state matches the database state recorded in phases 3-4

steps.action: Request a CMA from the site as the test buyer (from a saved home or the dashboard). Confirm the system generates it.
assertions: SQL: select id, slug, client_email, status, delivered_at, html_path from cmas where lower(client_email) like '%buyertest%' order by created_at desc

steps.action: Confirm the CMA email arrives at the test inbox.
assertions: SQL: select event, subject, occurred_at from email_events where lower(recipient_email) like '%buyertest%' order by occurred_at

steps.action: Open the CMA link from the email and read every page. rr-doc-tracker.js on /cma/[slug] posts to /api/track/e/* which upserts crm_timeline. Verify the view/click events landed against the test person.
assertions: SQL: select id, ts, kind, title from crm_timeline where person_id = <crm_person_id> order by ts desc

steps.action: S0 data accuracy: trace every number displayed in the CMA to the live database. Write one verification line per figure to a trace file next to results.json.
assertions: Every displayed figure has a source query whose fresh result equals the displayed value

steps.action: Create a market report on the fly for each of the four saved-search geographies (RiverWest, Old Bend, multi-family Bend, multi-family Redmond). Record which table the surface actually writes.
assertions: Four reports exist and are addressable by URL

steps.action: Send all four reports to the test email. Confirm all four arrive, click through each, and verify send + click tracking rows (email_events and/or crm_timeline) for the test identity.
assertions: SQL: select event, subject, occurred_at from email_events where lower(recipient_email) like '%buyertest%' order by occurred_at

steps.action: Confirm exactly one crm_people row exists for the test identity (no duplicates) and its timeline holds the journey's events.
assertions: SQL: select count(*) from crm_people where emails::text ilike '%buyertest%' and deleted = false

steps.action: Tag or delete the test lead, its saved data, and its events so analytics and lead counts stay clean. Record exactly what was done.
assertions: Test data cannot pollute lead counts or analytics
